pa.s: 3 SOURCE ROCK CHARACTERIZATION Forty two (SWC, DC and COPL) samples from the interval 3442-3922 MDRT were subjected to TOC/Rock Eval analyses. These were all Upper Jurassic claystones. As outlined in the introduction the OBM contamination is severe in the ditch cuttings and SWCs and all samples were thus pre-extracted an

similar analytical program as the fluid (water) samples.
